title: powertoys can no longer update automatically
author: Sec-Joe
summary: PowerToys 0.100.2 cannot complete its normal automatic update to the new four-component 0.101 build, matching the known legacy version-parser transition.

status.label: Known 0.101 update transition
status.detail: The screenshots and release-note discussion match the established old-client parser limitation already covered by Issue 50240.

next_action.label: Post manual-update guidance
next_action.reason: Affected pre-0.101 clients require one manual update before normal updating resumes.

judgment.rationale: This is another report of the known transition where older clients cannot complete automatic update after the 0.101 version-format/release transition. The discussion already points at the release notes, and the actionable response is manual-update guidance rather than a new design.
evidence: The affected installation is PowerToys 0.100.2 using PowerToys auto-update.
The issue includes updater screenshots and asks why automatic updating cannot proceed.
A commenter points to the release notes for the transition.
Issue 50240 tracks the same old-client update limitation and manual recovery path.
The issue now carries Area-Setup/Install in addition to Issue-Bug and Needs-Triage.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate with issue 50240 and advise one manual installation of the current release.

issue_context.summary: An older PowerToys client cannot automatically cross the release-version format transition introduced with 0.101.
known_information: The report concerns automatic updating from PowerToys 0.100.2.
Screenshots of the updater behavior are present.
The discussion references the release-note warning for this update transition.
Issue 50240 tracks the same updater/version-parser behavior.
inferences: This is likely the known one-time update transition rather than a new updater regression.
issue_context.analysis: The supplied evidence already identifies the documented release transition. Requesting diagnostics would not change the recovery path; the useful maintainer action is consolidation and precise manual-update guidance.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue body and both screenshot comments.
Compared the scenario with the established diagnosis in Issue 50240.
Updated labels from live state: Issue-Bug, Area-Setup/Install, Needs-Triage.

actions.label: Post 0.101 manual-update guidance

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshots. This matches the known one-time update transition tracked in Issue 50240: older PowerToys clients cannot complete the normal automatic update after the release version format changed for 0.101. Please install the current PowerToys release manually once from the official release or Microsoft Store; automatic updates should resume from that current version. The release-note warning referenced above documents the same transition.
